title.zh: 将阿尔拜省黎牙实比市Rawis描笼涯的Pag-Asa国立中学更名为黎牙实比市国立中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Pag-Asa National High School in Barangay Rawis, City of Legazpi, Province of Albay, to Legazpi City National High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Pag-Asa National High School in Barangay Rawis, City of Legazpi, Province of Albay, to Legazpi City National High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Pag-Asa tại Barangay Rawis, Thành phố Legazpi, Tỉnh Albay thành Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Legazpi City
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Pag-Asa ในบารังไกย์ Rawis, เมือง Legazpi, จังหวัด Albay เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Legazpi City
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Pag-Asa di Barangay Rawis, Kota Legazpi, Provinsi Albay menjadi Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Legazpi City
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Pag-Asa di Barangay Rawis, Bandaraya Legazpi, Wilayah Albay menjadi Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Legazpi City

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2021/ra_11526_2021.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Pag-Asa National High School in Barangay Rawis, City of Legazpi, Province of Albay, is hereby changed to Legazpi City National High School.
The main campus of the Legazpi City National High School shall continue to remain in its present location in Barangay Rawis, City of Legazpi, Province of Albay.
This Act shall be take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
